crossRefs.note: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
“My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.
If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
“Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door…
When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the…
As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name…

translations.web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
translations.bsb: He draws near to the Pit, and his life to the messengers of death.
translations.kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
translations.asv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.
